title: spec(formula): a `currency` hole with no argument still formats in US dollars — refuse it at authoring in every template dialect (follow-up of #26660)
body:
Filing gate: ① a silent default that triage ruled out, measured by in-flight work. Found while landing #26660 item (b) (PR #26937): the dev's os-dev-report on #26660 (6455019677, open question 1, with a census). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets lane and grade (spec lane suggested).

**Business reason.** `{{ amount | currency }}` with no argument formats the amount in US dollars, whatever currency the record is in. An author who forgets the argument gets a wrong-currency email or page with no refusal anywhere. That is the silent default currency the first triage on #26660 ruled out (6441491903: "⛔ Never a silent default currency"). PR #26799 removed the USD fallback for a bad argument, and PR #26937 adds `currency:@path` for mail; only the no-argument form still defaults to USD.

## Measured (census on `6090bb73`, by the #26660 dev; generated, CHANGELOG and release files excluded)

- Shipped templates that rely on it: examples 0, seeds 0, skills 0, apps 0.
- Prose and describes that show it: docs 2 (`content/docs/automation/flows.mdx:472`, `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx:79`, both in-app); spec describes / comments 4 (`flow-text-slot-template.ts:23`, `io-node-config.zod.ts:161`, `:632`, `:686`); service-automation 2 (`notify-node.ts:810`, `builtin/template.ts:104`); example prose 2 (the formula invalid-hole message, migration `18.flow-text-slot-single-brace-refused.ts:24`).
- Tests that pin the USD output: 4 (`formula` `template-formatters.test.ts:19`, `template-hole-grammar.test.ts:114`, `plugin-email` `template-engine.test.ts:79`, `template-hole-grammar.render.test.ts:110`), plus 3 fixtures carrying the hole.

## Wanted (the spec seat decides the shape)

- Refuse a no-argument `currency` at authoring in every dialect that shares the formatter (mail, in-app templates, flow text slots, action / bulk-action copy), with the prescription `currency:USD` for a fixed code, or `currency:@path` in mail once #26937 lands. Same judge as `email-template-hole-grammar` / the shared hole grammar in `@objectstack/formula`.
- Render never formats a no-argument `currency` in USD silently.
- Migrate the 2 docs, the describes and comments, and re-pin the 4 tests to the refusal.
- BREAKING: a stored template with a no-argument `currency` is refused at its next publish. ADR-0087 disposition: likely a D3 note (the conversion cannot know which currency was meant).

**Clause-②:** likely `no (narrowing)`. **Metadata-protocol:** likely `narrowed`. Skills / docs / eval owed under #26369 B.

Land after PR #26937 (#26660), which touches the same grammar files.
